spans.s: कलकण्ठ m. ई f. N. of sev. birds.
कलकण्ठिका f. the female Indian cuckoo.
कलकण्ठिन् m. the Indian cuckoo.
कलकल m. confused noise, buz, humming.

कलङ्क m. spot, mark (l.&f.);
 poss. ˚किन्.
कलञ्ज m. tobacco.
कलत्र n. wife or any female being.
कलत्रवन्त् a. having a wife.
कल˚त्रिन् a. having a wife.

कलधौत n. gold or silver;
 adj. = seq.
कलभ m. a young elephant or camel.
कलभाषिन् a. speaking softly.
कलम m. a kind of rice.
कलमकेदार m. a rice-field.*
कलमौदन s. boiled rice.*
कलवि॑न्क m. sparrow or the Indian cuckoo.
कल॑श m. ई f. pot, water-jar (adj. —˚ f. ई).
कलस v. कलश.
कलशोदक n. the water in the jar.
कलह m. strife, quarrel.
कलहंसगामिनी f. moving like a swan.*
कलहकार f. ई causing quarrel, quarrelsome.
कलहप्रिय a. fond of quarrel, contentious.
कलहवन्त् a. having quarrel with (सह).
कल˚हिन् a. having quarrel with (सह).
कलहाय् कलहा˚यते quarrel, contend.

कलाज्ञ a. knowing the arts;
 m. an artist.
कालज्ञ a. knowing the (proper) times.
कलानाथ m. the moon.
कलानिधि m. the moon.

कलापिन् a. having a quiver with arrows or spreading its
tail, m. a peacock.
कलाभृत् m. an artist, mechanic.
कलावन्त् m. the moon.
कलाविद a. = कलान्ज.
कलाशेष a. forming only a small sickle (moon).
कलिकाता f. the city of Calcutta.
कलिङ्ग m. N. of a king, pl. of a people.
कलिङ्गदेश m. the country of the Kaliṅgas.
कलित a. furnished with (˚— or —˚).
कलितकुसुम a. furnished with flowers, budded.
कलिन्दकन्या f. E. of Yamuna.
कलिन्द˚तनया f. E. of Yamuna.

कलिल a. covered with, full of (—˚);
 n. confusion, chaos.
कलुषचेतस् a. having impure thoughts.
कलुष˚मति a. having impure thoughts.
कलुषय् कलुष˚यति make turbid, soil.
कलुषाय् कलुषा˚यते get turbid or troubled.
कलुषयोनिज a. of impure origin, base born.
कलुषी@कृ make turbid, trouble.
कलेवर n. (m.) the body.

कल्क m. dough, paste;
 dirt, sin.
कल्कि m. N. of a future liberator of the world.
कल्किन् m. N. of a future liberator of the world.

क॑ल्प a. feasible, possible;
 fit for, able to, capable of
(gen., loc., inf., or —˚). m. ordinance, rule, esp. for ceremonial or
sacrificial acts, practise, custom, manner, way (adj. —˚ having the
manner or way of —. i.e. resembling —, similar to —;
 after an adj.
almost, as it were);
 a fabulous period of time, a day of Brahman or 1000
yugas. एतेन कल्पेन in this way. प्रथमः कल्पः or
प्रथमकल्पः primary rule (opp. अनुकल्प), chief matter, main
point.
कल्पक्षय m. the end of a Kalpa.
कल्पतरु m. the (mythic) Wish or Wonder-tree.
कल्पद्रुम m. the (mythic) Wish or Wonder-tree.
कल्पधेनु f. the (mythic) Wish or Wonder-cow.

कल्पनीय a. practicable, possible, to be supposed or
stated.
कल्पपादप m. = कल्पतरु.
कल्पवृक्ष m. = कल्पतरु.
कल्पसूत्र n. a Sutra work on ritual.
कल्पादि m. the beginning of a Kalpa (v. seq.).
कल्पान्त m. the end of a Kalpa, destruction of the world.
कल्मलि॑ s. splendour.
कल्मलीकि॑न् a. shining, bright.
कल्मष n. dirt, stain, sin.

काल्य n. daybreak;
 loc. & acc. at daybreak, early.
कल्याणकटक s. N. of a place.
कल्याणकृत् a. doing good, virtuous.

कल्याणसूचक a. indicating fortune^1 auspicious.*
[1] Correction submitted by AnnaRybakovaT, Jim Funderburk. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/25.
कल्लोल m. wave, billow.
कल्हण m. N. of an author.
2 कालक (f. कालिका) monthly.
कालकञ्ज॑ m. pl. N. of a race of Asuras.
कालकण्ठक m. sparrow.
कालकर्मन् n. death (lit. the work of time).
कालकारित a. temporary (lit. caused by time).
कालकृत a. temporary, passing (lit. made by time).
कालक्षम a. durable, lasting (lit. bearing time).
कालचक्र n. the time (thought as) a wheel.
कालजिह्व a. black-tongued.
कालज्ञान n. knowledge of time or chronology.
कालदण्ड m. the staff of Death.
कालधर्म m. the law of time, i.e. death.
कालध˚र्मन् m. the law of time, i.e. death.
कालनेमि m. N. of an Asura.
कालपक्व a. ripened by time.
कालपक्वभुज् a. eating things ripened by time.

कालपरशुधार m. executioner (lit. bearer of the
axe of Death).*
कालपर्यय m. the course of time.
काल˚पर्याय m. the course of time.
कालपाश m. the sling of Death.

कालपाशस्थित a. being in the sling (i.e. on the
brink) of death.
कालप्राप्त a. come with or produced by time.

कालयोग m. a connection with or arrangement of time.
˚तस् according to circumstances.
कालप्रियनाथ m. E. of Śiva.
कालवर्षिन् a. raining in time.
कालवाल a. black-tailed.
कालविद् a. & काल˚विद्या f. = कालज्ञ & काल˚ज्ञान.
कालविभक्ति f. division of time.
कालवृद्धि f. periodical (not legal) interest.
कालशाक m. a kind of pot-herb.

कालसंरोध m. keeping (of a pledge) for a long
time.
कालसर्प m. coluber naga.
कालहरण n. ˚हार m. loss of time, delay.
कालागुरु m. a black kind of Agallochum.
कालातिपात m. loss of time, delay.
कालात्यय m. lapse of time, prescription (j.).
कालानुसार्य s. a kind of gum.

कालान्तर n. another time or intermediate time,
interval, delay. — Instr. & abl. after some delay.
कालान्तरक्षम a. bearing a delay, patient.
कालायस n. iron, adj. made of iron.
कालायसदृढ a. iron-hard.
कालिदास m. N. of several poets.

कालिन्द n. water-melon, f. ई patr. of the Yamuna river;
a. coming from this river.
कालिमन् m. blackness.
